facts.value: Extracts Fighter* fp from gobj and calls ft_80081D0C with gobj alone. On true, passes gobj, fp, ftLk_MS_SpecialLw and coll_mf to ftCommon_AirToGroundStateChange, then assigns spawnBomb to accessory4_cb. The inline calls ftCommon_8007D7FC(fp) and forwards cur_anim_frame, speed 1 and blend 0 to Fighter_ChangeMotionState.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline predicate argument error and records independently verified current-frame flow.

evidence.why: Exact predicate, transition arguments and callback write.

facts.value: Unconditionally delegates to ft_80084F3C with no local motion-state transition. That helper starts with ground_friction, multiplies it by friction_when_above_walk_speed only when ABS(gr_vel) > walk_max_vel, then applies ground friction and ground movement. Equality does not scale friction. Source does not establish that the multiplier exceeds one or that every possible attribute value produces deceleration.
facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported stronger-friction wording with the strict comparison and data-dependent scaling.

evidence.why: Strict overspeed test, attribute multiplier and movement operations.

facts.value: Consumes throw_flags_b0 through ftCheckThrowB0 before attempting creation. Resolves FtPart_LThumbNb and calls lb_8000B1CC(joint,NULL,&pos); forwards gobj, &pos, fp->ft_data->x8->x10, da->x48 and facing_dir to it_8029DD58. Despite the local Fighter_Part declaration, the constructor consumes da->x48 as SpawnItem.kind, copies the supplied vector into prev_pos and obtains pos separately. Stores the result, including NULL, in item_gobj; calls ftParts_80074A4C(gobj,2,1) after either constructor outcome; invokes ftpickupitem_80094818(gobj,1) only for non-NULL. No local held-slot recheck, automatic failed-attempt retry or callback self-unregistration is present.
facts.rationale: Records canonical event consumption, constructor argument roles, copied stack-vector lifetime and allocation-failure boundary without exact-position inference.

evidence.why: Throw bit is cleared on successful test.
Constructor kind and distinct prev_pos/pos handling.

facts.value: Entry has three cases: empty item_gobj permits ground/air pull initialization; a held item with unsigned kind offset 0 or 1 from It_Kind_Link_Bomb invokes ftCo_800957F4 with literal motion ID 108 or 112 and suppresses pull initialization; every other held item also suppresses pull initialization without that call. A consumed throw-bit event later attempts creation, with pickup only for non-NULL. Collision transitions select the paired pull state at cur_anim_frame and reinstall spawnBomb. Animation completion invokes the common grounded neutral path or Fall. Link and CLink motion tables share these action callbacks.
facts.rationale: Repairs the omitted non-bomb held-item case and records verified callback sharing and transition boundaries.

evidence.why: All local entry, creation, animation and collision branches.
